name: TetWeave Late-Stage Optimization
definition: A late-stage optimization phase for TetWeave that refines the Signed Distance Field (SDF), point positions, and spherical harmonics coefficients without updating the tetrahedral grid topology, using mask, depth, normal, and SDF regularization losses.
summary: TetWeave Late-Stage Optimization refines SDF values, point positions, and spherical harmonics coefficients using multi-view rendering losses while keeping the tetrahedral mesh topology unchanged.
